title: Importance factors.
officialText:
Importance factors for snow, wind and seismic loads shall be determined in accordance with Table
1604.5.2 based on the Structural Occupancy Category or Risk Category assigned in accordance with Table 1604.5.
TABLE 1604.5.2
IMPORTANCE FACTORS
Structural Snow Importance Wind Importance Seismic Importance
Occupancy/Risk Category Factor, I Factor, I Factor, I
I 0.80 0.87 1.00
II 1.00 1.00 1.00
III 1.10 1.15 1.25
IV 1.20 1.15 1.50
